problem:
For the matrix
$P=[\begin{aligned}2 & x & 3 \\ y & 5 & 4 \\ 1 & 2y & x\end{aligned}],$
find the minor ${M}_{23}$ of the element ${p}_{23}.$

${M}_{23}=${{field-1}}
worked_solution:
To evaluate the minor of ${p}_{23},$ we remove the second row and third column:

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}2 & x & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & 4 \\ 1 & 2y & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor of ${p}_{23}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{23} & =det[\begin{aligned}2 & x \\ 1 & 2y\end{aligned}] \\  & =|\begin{aligned}2 & x \\ 1 & 2y\end{aligned}| \\  & =2\cdot (2y)-x\cdot 1 \\  & =4y-x.\end{aligned}
$$
